c0016.en: Designed by John Guerrero — chef and restaurant consultant since 2010, in professional kitchens since age 17 · johnguerrero.es

c0038.en: Clean uniform and work shoes, fresh apron, hair tied back and covered (cap or hairnet)

c0039.en: No hand/arm jewelry except a plain band; nails short, clean, no polish or acrylics

c0040.en: Cover cuts and wounds with a waterproof, brightly colored bandage and a glove on top

c0042.en: Check no one has vomiting, diarrhea, jaundice, sore throat with fever or an infected cut; if so, no food handling (FDA 2-201.11)

c0043.en: Turn on the exhaust hood and ventilate the kitchen BEFORE lighting anything else

c0074.en: APPROXIMATE FREEZER SHELF LIFE AT 0 °F — adjust it to your product and your supplier

c0088.en: Fat goes rancid even when frozen: it spoils first

c0107.en: Use the dropdown: ✓, — or N/A. N/A = not applicable, comes out of the total; — = not done, counts as pending.

c0468.en: ▸ Each task comes with Assigned to and Due by preloaded with the kit's criteria: adjust them to your real schedule, they are green cells.

c0470.en: ▸ Everything filled in daily is GREEN: Assigned to, Due by, ✓ Done, Initials and Notes.

c0472.en: ▸ Mark ✓ in the "✓ Done" column (dropdown): that is the column that counts completed tasks.

c0474.en: ▸ The denominator counts the tasks written in the "Task" column, not a fixed number: if you add or delete tasks, the total adjusts by itself.

c0476.en: ▸ At the end of each table there are 5 free green rows INSIDE the range the counter covers: write your own tasks there.

c0477.en: ▸ If you need more, insert rows INSIDE the table (right-click → Insert), never below the last one: anything typed outside the range is not counted.

c0479.en: ▸ Sheets with formulas are protected WITHOUT a password: the input cells (the green ones) are unlocked, so calculations never get overwritten by accident.

c0480.en: ▸ You can insert and delete rows with protection on. To change the structure: Review → Unprotect Sheet.

c0497.en: Turn on the main lights (interior and exterior)

c0499.en: Turn on HVAC / heat depending on the season

c0500.en: Raise security gate and open front door

c0503.en: Turn on the POS / card terminal

c0513.en: Check cleanliness of common areas (entrance, hallways)

c0530.en: Turn off the POS / card terminal (or leave on standby)

c0536.en: Empty trash cans in common areas and restrooms
